responsibility: This file implements the NDS32 backend’s custom expansion of bulk memory operations and multiple-register transfers. It emits target-specific RTL for cpymem, setmem, cmpmem/strlen-style scanning, and load_multiple/store_multiple by choosing between unrolled sequences, loops, post-increment addressing, and lmw/smw-style block moves based on optimization level, alignment, ISA features, and register availability. It is the code-generation engine behind the memory-manipulation patterns declared in nds32-multiple.md.
